title: enhance_prompt tool schema
description: Synchronous prompt enhancement utility for expanding or adapting a source prompt into a model-ready image, video, music, or edit prompt.

prompt.description: The source prompt, rough idea, or prompt revision request to enhance.

target_output.description: The kind of prompt artifact to produce.

destination_model.description: Optional destination model selector, such as seedance2, ltx23, wan22, flux2, gpt-image-2, or sdxl.

destination_tool.description: Optional downstream generation tool, such as generate_image, edit_image, generate_video, animate_photo, sound_to_video, video_to_video, or generate_music.

prompting_type.description: Optional image-prompting family when producing an image prompt.

model_title.description: Optional human-readable target model name for image prompt guidance.

style_prompt.description: Optional current style, brand, or prompt context to complement without repeating.

duration_seconds.description: Requested runtime when enhancing a video or music prompt.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional target aspect ratio, such as 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, or 21:9.

assets.description: Optional available assets the enhanced prompt may reference.

constraints.description: Optional production, brand, model, or user constraints to preserve.
